lines.text: RECEPTIONIST: Oh, welcome!\nAre you here to meet the president?\c\nYou’ll find him in the boardroom on 11F!

I heard that the ones who took on Team Rocket
were actually some kids!\c
Wait, could it be you...?
No, no, couldn’t be...

Any kind of tool can be used for good or evil,
depending on the person using it.\c
I shudder to think what would have happened
if Team Rocket had gotten their hands on
Silph technology...
I came back from playing hooky only to find out\nthe company had been taken over!\r\nThat was quite a surprise, for sure.
A lot of work’s piled up, so we need to\nget cracking!
I was captured by Team Rocket. I wonder if our\ninsurance plan covers that kind of thing...?
